description: This is a Java test class for the AnyKeyboardView component in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It contains unit tests for touch interactions, theme application, watermark rendering, and gesture handling within the keyboard view.

classes.name: AnyKeyboardViewTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the behavior of the AnyKeyboardView component, including touch interactions, theme application, watermark rendering, and gesture handling.

methods.name: createViewToTest
methods.description: Creates an instance of AnyKeyboardView for testing, overriding setValueFromTheme to track theme application.

methods.name: setCreatedKeyboardView
methods.description: Sets the created keyboard view instance for testing.

methods.name: testKeyClickHappyPath
methods.description: Tests the sequence of events when a key is tapped, including press, release, and gesture start.

methods.name: testKeyRepeatClickHappyPath
methods.description: Tests the behavior of holding down a key to trigger repeated key events.

methods.name: testDisregardIfSameTheme
methods.description: Verifies that setting the same theme does not trigger reapplication.

methods.name: testKeyClickDomain
methods.description: Tests clicking the domain key and the appearance of the mini keyboard popup.

methods.name: testThemeIsNotSetInConstructor
methods.description: Checks that the theme is not set during the constructor call.

methods.name: testMinimumPadding
methods.description: Ensures the bottom padding respects minimum values based on resources.

methods.name: testTouchIsDisabledOnGestureUntilAllPointersAreUp
methods.description: Verifies touch disablement during swipe gestures until all pointers are lifted.

methods.name: testSlideToNextKeyHappyPath
methods.description: Tests sliding from one key to the next, verifying correct key events.

methods.name: testSlideToExtensionKeyboard
methods.description: Tests the behavior of sliding to reveal the extension (popup) keyboard.

methods.name: testSlideToExtensionKeyboardWhenDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that extension keyboard does not appear when disabled in preferences.

methods.name: testSlideToExtensionKeyboardWhenNotExceedingThreshold
methods.description: Ensures extension keyboard does not appear if slide distance does not exceed threshold.

methods.name: testSwipeSpaceUpToUtilitiesKeyboardWithGestureTyping
methods.description: Tests swipe up gesture to open utility keyboard with gesture typing enabled.

methods.name: testDoesNotReportGestureDoneWhenTwoFingersAreUsed
methods.description: Verifies that gesture completion is not reported when multiple fingers are used.

methods.name: testReportGestureDoneHappyPath
methods.description: Tests the sequence of gesture start, input, and completion reporting.

methods.name: testSwipeUpToUtilitiesKeyboard
methods.description: Tests the swipe up gesture to open the utility keyboard.

methods.name: assertSwipeUpToUtilitiesKeyboard
methods.description: Helper method to verify swipe up gesture triggers utility keyboard and hides it.

methods.name: testQuickTextPopupHappyPath
methods.description: Tests the quick text popup key activation.

methods.name: testLongPressEnter
methods.description: Verifies long press behavior on the Enter key, including secondary actions.

methods.name: testEdgeTouchLeftKeyA
methods.description: Tests touching the left edge of the 'a' key triggers the key event.

methods.name: testEdgeTouchRightKeyL
methods.description: Tests touching the right edge of the 'l' key triggers the key event.

methods.name: testDoesNotAddExtraDrawIfAnimationsAreOff
methods.description: Verifies that extra drawing is skipped if animations are disabled.

methods.name: testDoesNotAddExtraDrawIfRtlWorkaround
methods.description: Verifies that extra drawing is skipped if RTL workaround is disabled.

methods.name: testExtraDrawMultiple
methods.description: Tests multiple extra draw objects and their invocation during onDraw.

methods.name: testWithLongPressDeleteKeyOutput
methods.description: Verifies long press on delete key outputs the correct key code sequence.

methods.name: testWatermarkSetsBounds
methods.description: Checks that watermark drawables are assigned correct bounds.

methods.name: testWatermarkDrawn
methods.description: Verifies that watermark drawables are drawn on the canvas.

methods.name: testSwipeDownWhenGestureTypingIsDisabled
methods.description: Tests that swipe down triggers the correct action when gesture typing is off.

methods.name: testSmallSwipeDownWhenGestureTypingIsEnabled
methods.description: Tests that small swipe down does not trigger the action when gesture typing is on.

methods.name: testLargeSwipeDownWhenGestureTypingIsEnabled
methods.description: Tests that a large swipe down triggers the gesture action when gesture typing is on.
